scripts.build: bun --cwd packages/contracts build && bun --cwd packages/db build && bun --cwd packages/media build && bun --cwd server build && bun --cwd worker build && bun --cwd web build
scripts.lint: oxlint . && uv run --project sdk --frozen ruff check --config ruff.toml scripts sdk
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint . --fix && uv run --project sdk --frozen ruff check --fix --config ruff.toml scripts sdk
scripts.format: oxfmt . && uv run --project sdk --frozen ruff format --config ruff.toml scripts sdk
scripts.format:check: oxfmt . --check && uv run --project sdk --frozen ruff format --check --config ruff.toml scripts sdk
scripts.typecheck: bun --cwd packages/contracts typecheck && bun --cwd packages/db typecheck && bun --cwd packages/media typecheck && bun --cwd server typecheck && bun --cwd worker typecheck && bun --cwd web typecheck
scripts.test: bun run test:storage-bootstrap && bun run test:dev-host && bun run --cwd packages/contracts test && bun run --cwd packages/db test && bun run --cwd packages/media test && bun run --cwd server test && bun run --cwd worker test && bun run --cwd web test && uv run --project sdk --frozen --extra test pytest sdk/tests
scripts.graphql:schema:check: bun run graphql:schema && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts/graphql/schema.graphql && bun run graphql:operations:check
scripts.test:db-server: bun run --cwd packages/db test && bun run --cwd server test
scripts.validate:all: python scripts/validate_contracts.py && python scripts/validate_scaffold.py && python scripts/validate_prisma_structure.py && node scripts/validate_typescript_syntax.mjs
scripts.compose:up: bun run dev:infra && docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.yaml --profile app up --build
